build_BaselineModel: build a BaselineModel with a processor factory and spec to train on CLRS algorithmic reasoning tasks
build_BaselineModelChunked: build a BaselineModelChunked to train on time-chunked CLRS data with fixed-length chunks
create_GAT_processor: create a GAT processor with configurable attention heads and output size for graph message passing
create_MPNN_processor: create an MPNN processor for message-passing neural network inference on graph-structured CLRS data
build_Net: build a Net module with encoders decoders and a processor factory for CLRS graph neural network inference
